sub.zh: 撒母耳记上 16 · 这件事的开头

flags_note: 1 Samuel 16:1-13, seen by the witness after the valley. The anointing is Scripture; the townspeople are invented and say nothing Scripture contradicts.

exits.note: the south road back down to the valley

text.en: The old man at the gate looks you over and speaks first.
text.zh: 城门边的老人看了你一眼，先开了口。

text.en: “You are not from this town. Then I will tell you: Samuel is here.”
text.zh: 「你不是本镇的人。那我告诉你：撒母耳来了。」

text.en: He came up the road at first light with a horn at his side. The elders went out to meet him.
text.zh: 天刚亮他顺着大路上来，腰间带着一只角。长老们出去迎他，腿都在抖。

text.en: Since then nobody in the town has gone back to work.
text.zh: 从那以后，镇上没人再回去干活。

text.en: “Jesse's house is up by the wall. Go and see. When you come back down, tell me what he wanted.”
text.zh: 「耶西家在城墙边。你自己上去看。下来时告诉我他要什么。」

text.en: Seventy years I have lived here. I have never seen the whole street stand still like this.
text.zh: 我在这儿住了七十年，没见过整条街这样站着不动。

text.en: A woman at the well has drawn two buckets and carries neither away.
text.zh: 井边的妇人打了两桶水，一桶也没提走。

text.en: “The youngest one went out with the flock before dawn. He does not even know the prophet is here.”
text.zh: 「最小的那个天没亮就赶羊出去了。他还不知道先知到了。」

text.en: “Seven sons Jesse has. Seven. And the one who ends up watching the sheep is always the youngest.”
text.zh: 「耶西有七个儿子。七个。可守着羊的，总是最小的那个。」

text.en: When you find him, tell him the water is sweet this morning. He will laugh at that.
text.zh: 你找到他的时候，跟他说今早的水是甜的。他会笑。

text.en: “I have brought them all, as you asked. Eliab first — he is the eldest.”
text.zh: 「你要看，我把他们都带来了。先是以利押，他是长子。」

text.en: He keeps one hand on the doorframe while he says it.
text.zh: 他说这话的时候，一只手一直扶着门框。

text.en: “He has not told me which one he wants. I brought them all.”
text.zh: 「他没说要找哪一个。我就把他们都叫来了。」

text.en: “You came up the road with the crowd. Do you know what they are saying about our father's house?”
text.zh: 「你是跟着人从大路上来的吧。你知道他们在说我们家什么吗？」

text.en: “Nothing. That is what. The prophet looks at me and says nothing at all.”
text.zh: 「什么也没说。他就看了我一眼，什么也没说。」

text.en: I am the eldest. He did not say a word to me.
text.zh: 我是长子。他连一句话都没跟我说。

text.en: The old prophet sits with his hands on his knees. He does not hurry to speak.
text.zh: 老先知坐着，两手放在膝上。他没急着开口。

text.en: “You came up with the crowd. Sit down and watch. Say nothing.”
text.zh: 「你是跟着人上来的。坐下看着，别说话。」

text.en: Jesse's sons stand in a row by the wall, the eldest first, tall as a door.
text.zh: 耶西的儿子们靠着墙站成一排，长子在前，高得像一扇门。

text.en: “You are still here. Good. Stand where you are and watch.”
text.zh: 「你还在。好。站在那儿看着就行。」

text.en: The sheep are spread over the slope. The boy with them still has the stick in his hand.
text.zh: 羊在坡上散着。看羊的孩子手里还拿着棍子。

text.en: “You are a long way from the road. Did my father send you? He sends for me when there is a feast, and never before.”
text.zh: 「你离大路很远。是我父亲叫你来的吗？他只在摆席的时候才叫我，从来不会早一点。」

text.en: “The prophet is at the house. I heard the women say it. Nobody here has slept well for two days.”
text.zh: 「先知在家里。我听妇人们说了。这两天镇上都没睡好。」

text.en: I will come. But the sheep come too — they do not know the way back without me.
text.zh: 我去。可羊也得跟着。没有我，它们不认得回来的路。

text.en: “You came a long way to stand in a field. Sit, if you like. They do not mind strangers.”
text.zh: 「你大老远跑来，站在田里。要坐就坐吧，它们不认生。」

gate.en: Ask the elder at the gate why the town has stopped working.
gate.zh: 问问城门边的长老：镇上为什么停了工。

house.en: Go up to Jesse's house. The old man from Ramah is waiting there.
house.zh: 到耶西家去。那位从拉玛来的老人正在那里等着。

field.en: Call the youngest son in from the field. He is with the sheep.
field.zh: 到田里去，把最小的儿子叫回来。他正在放羊。

return.en: Bring him back to Samuel, at Jesse's house.
return.zh: 把他带回去，带回到耶西家里的撒母耳面前。

done.en: The oil has been poured. The south road leads back down to the valley.
done.zh: 膏油已经倒出。南边那条路，通回山谷。

corin.en: Speak to the elder at the gate.
corin.zh: 先去和城门边的长老说话。

npc.en: Speak to the people of the town.

text.en: Bethlehem sits high; the wind came off the hills all night. Nobody has started work this morning. People are standing in their doorways.
text.zh: 伯利恒地势高，夜里山风没停过。今早没人开工，人都站在门口。

text.en: The road climbs, and the town sits small on its hill: a well, a threshing floor, roofs of clay. Bethlehem of Judah.
text.zh: 路是往上走的。城很小，搁在山上：一口井，一块打谷场，几间泥屋顶。犹大的伯利恒。

text.en: The gate is open and nobody is working. People stand in the street without saying much.
text.zh: 城门开着，没人干活。人都在街上站着，不说话。

text.en:
[Scripture] 1 Samuel 16:7
But the LORD said unto Samuel, Look not on his countenance, or on the height of his stature; because I have refused him:
text.zh:
【经文】撒母耳记上 16:7
耶和华却对撒母耳说：不要看他的外貌和他身材高大，我不拣选他。

text.en: for the LORD seeth not as man seeth; for man looketh on the outward appearance, but the LORD looketh on the heart.
text.zh: 因为，耶和华不像人看人：人是看外貌；耶和华是看内心。

text.en: Eliab steps back. Abinadab steps forward, and then Shammah, and the prophet's face does not change for either of them.
text.zh: 以利押退回去。亚比拿达上前，然后是沙玛。先知看他们两个人的时候，脸上都没有变。

text.en:
[Scripture] 1 Samuel 16:10
Again, Jesse made seven of his sons to pass before Samuel. And Samuel said unto Jesse, The LORD hath not chosen these.
text.zh:
【经文】撒母耳记上 16:10
耶西叫他七个儿子都从撒母耳面前经过，撒母耳对耶西说：这都不是耶和华所拣选的。

text.en:
[Scripture] 1 Samuel 16:11
And Samuel said unto Jesse, Are here all thy children?
text.zh:
【经文】撒母耳记上 16:11
撒母耳对耶西说：你的儿子都在这里吗？

text.en: And he said, There remaineth yet the youngest, and, behold, he keepeth the sheep.
text.zh: 他回答说：还有个小的，现在放羊。

text.en: And Samuel said unto Jesse, Send and fetch him: for we will not sit down till he come hither.
text.zh: 撒母耳对耶西说：你打发人去叫他来；他若不来，我们必不坐席。

text.en: Nobody moves. Then everyone in the room turns to look at you.
text.zh: 没有人动。屋里的人都转过头来看你。

text.en:
[Scripture] 1 Samuel 16:12
And he sent, and brought him in. Now he was ruddy, and withal of a beautiful countenance, and goodly to look to.
text.zh:
【经文】撒母耳记上 16:12
耶西就打发人去叫了他来。他面色光红，双目清秀，容貌俊美。

text.en: And the LORD said, Arise, anoint him: for this is he.
text.zh: 耶和华说：这就是他，你起来膏他。

text.en: The horn is heavy. The oil goes on a boy who has been in the sun all morning, in front of seven brothers who will not look at him.
text.zh: 角很沉。油倒在一个晒了一上午太阳的男孩头上，七位兄长站在旁边，谁也不看他。

text.en:
[Scripture] 1 Samuel 16:13
Then Samuel took the horn of oil, and anointed him in the midst of his brethren:
text.zh:
【经文】撒母耳记上 16:13
撒母耳就用角里的膏油，在他诸兄中膏了他。

text.en: and the Spirit of the LORD came upon David from that day forward. So Samuel rose up, and went to Ramah.
text.zh: 从这日起，耶和华的灵就大大感动大卫。撒母耳起身回拉玛去了。

text.en: Nobody speaks. He stands among his brothers with the oil still on his hair.
text.zh: 屋里没人说话。他站在几个哥哥中间，头发上还沾着油。

text.en: “The road back is down there. Go when you are ready. There is nothing for you to do here.”
text.zh: 「回去的路在下面。想走就走吧，这里没你要做的事了。」

missions.note: the town's fear; the witness learns why Bethlehem has stopped working

text.en: Seven sons, and the prophet has not moved for one of them. Something is missing from this house.
text.zh: 七个儿子，先知一个都没动。这家里还缺一个人。

text.en: He is out with the sheep, east of the town. Go and call him in.
text.zh: 他在镇东边放羊。去把他叫回来。

missions.note: the youngest son is not at the feast; the player fetches him
16:12-13, the anointing, and the chapter's closing beat

text.en: Two women are drawing water. One of them leaves her jar on the rim and walks back up the street without it.
text.zh: 两个妇人在打水。有一个把罐子搁在井沿上，空着手往街上回去了。

text.en: Under the oldest olive tree the ground is worn smooth. People still come here to wait for someone.
text.zh: 最老的那棵橄榄树下，地面被踩得发亮。至今还有人来这儿等人。
